rationale.consistency: Uses slices.Clone/Insert and maps.Clone like surrounding code; threads order through existing helpers; comment style matches package.
rationale.edge_cases: Chained order lines build on existingVal; invalid order errors before any state is stored; nil options handled; plugin RegisterDirectiveOrder still works and no longer aliases defaultDirectiveOrder.
rationale.scope: Focused on the order plumbing; the nil-options guard and explicit delete of "order" after cloning are slightly beyond need but harmless.
rationale.readability: directiveOrderForOptions is a clear single lookup point; comments explain the why; buildSubroute's order param unused when needsSorting=false is a small wart.
rationale.robustness: No global writes during adaptation, so concurrent adaptations are race-free; per-adaptation order lives in the cloned options map; default order is never mutated.
rationale.maintainability: Single accessor for the effective order avoids scattering; passing nil order from parseRoute couples callers to the needsSorting flag, a minor hidden dependency.
